title: I got a strange text or email: what you can do now
pageTitle: I got a strange text or email: what you can do now | Spamlock
description: A text or email you didn’t expect, asking you to act? Steps you can take now: don’t rush, check the link, contact the company yourself and report it.
answer: Take your time: don’t reply, tap links or call back. If it says it’s from a company, contact the company yourself using its official app or the number on your card.
stepsTitle: Steps you can take after a strange text or email

steps.title: Don’t reply, tap links or call back
steps.text: Scammers try to rush you. Take your time.

steps.title: Check any link first
steps.text: Paste the link, or the whole message, into Check a link in the Spamlock app. It tells you if the link shows warning signs or is known to be dangerous, without opening it.

steps.title: Contact the company yourself
steps.text: Use its official app or the number on your card. They can tell you if the message really came from them.

steps.title: Never share codes or passwords
steps.text: Real companies don’t ask for them by message.

steps.title: Report it as spam
steps.text: In the UK and US, forward the text to 7726. It’s free. Elsewhere, use the report junk or spam option in your messages app.

steps.title: Delete it and block the sender
steps.text: Once you’ve reported it. Blocking stops more messages from that sender.

app.title: This guide is in the Spamlock app
app.text: Check any link or QR code before you open it, and mark each step as done.
